response.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.production_type_code AS code,
         pc.product_type_description AS description,
         CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL) AS qty,
         ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost AS cost_diff
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
),
cat AS (
  SELECT code, description,
         AVG(qty) AS avg_qty,
         AVG(cost_diff) AS avg_diff
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY code, description
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM cat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT c.avg_qty, c.avg_diff
  FROM cat c, threshold t
  WHERE c.avg_diff > t.mean_diff
)
SELECT AVG(k.avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity,
       AVG(k.avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_cost_difference,
       AVG(k.avg_diff - t.mean_diff) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM kept k, threshold t;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity in Invoice_Line_Items holds numeric text, so CAST(... AS REAL) gives the quantity; non-numeric text would be silently coerced (SQLite yields 0) and distort the averages.

Categories are grouped by the pair (production_type_code, product_type_description); since the code is the primary key, this is the same as grouping by code. A line whose cost difference is missing still counts toward its category's quantity average, because missing values are skipped per metric rather than per line.
The 'mean of those category averages' is unweighted: each category's average cost difference counts once, regardless of how many lines it has.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Ignore missing values' means drop any line that is missing its quantity or either derived cost, so every category average is computed over the same complete lines.
alternatives.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.production_type_code AS code,
         pc.product_type_description AS description,
         CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL) AS qty,
         ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost AS cost_diff
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  WHERE ili.product_quantity IS NOT NULL
    AND ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
),
cat AS (
  SELECT code, description,
         AVG(qty) AS avg_qty,
         AVG(cost_diff) AS avg_diff
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY code, description
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM cat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT c.avg_qty, c.avg_diff
  FROM cat c, threshold t
  WHERE c.avg_diff > t.mean_diff
)
SELECT AVG(k.avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity,
       AVG(k.avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_cost_difference,
       AVG(k.avg_diff - t.mean_diff) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM kept k, threshold t;
